newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has asked leaders and workers of her Awami League not to show arrogance of power, rather demonstrate utmost restraint in dealing with people.
The Asian Development Bank is likely to put 150 million US dollar in a World Bank-designed infrastructure development project.
The final draft of the national AIDS policy is expected to be taken to the cabinet soon for approval.

Foreign Minister Abdus Samad Azad and visiting West Bengal Chief Minister Jyoti Basu discussed water sharing and other bilateral issues during a river cruise on Friday. An offocial, who accompanied them, said "the discussion is on the right track and leading towards a solution."

Secretary-general of opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has expressed concern at the propaganda branding his party workers of Kaliganj in Jhenaidah district as members of an outlawed party.
Speakers at a seminar in Dhaka have called for inclusion of all eligible countries including Bangladesh within the fold of the newly formed Indian Ocean Rim Association for regional cooperation.
